Display Name: Build as you learn: Resume & Cover Letter Lab (In-Person)
Details:
💻Have your laptop or paper copy of your resume or cover letter ready to work in real-time + receive support. You will leave this lab with a solid draft or major improvements using UTSA’s Career Center tools and examples.

Here’s what we’ll cover:

📄Purpose of a resume 
🧱Resume structure

Sections: Contact Info, Education, Experience, Skills
Formatting tips: Consistent margins, fonts, reverse-chronological order
Bullet points: Focus on action verbs + results
🔍Review resume examples
🤖Introduce  VMock  resume features (check out our AI/VMock Labs  for a deeper dive)
🧾Purpose of a cover letter & structure
✍️Live working session to work on your resume and/or cover letter

Display Name: Prescribe Your Path: Steps Toward a Health Profession Career Lab
Details:
🩺This Health Professions Lab is designed to give you a foundational overview and help you make informed decisions about your next steps. Whether you’re just beginning to explore a career in healthcare or you are already committed to a specific path, this Health Professions Lab will help you understand key steps on how to prepare academically and professionally as well as learn about key resources & support to help you succeed. 



Here’s what we’ll cover:

🔍 What is the Health Professions Office ?
🏥 Exploring careers in the medical field
✅ Understanding prerequisites for program(s) of interest
🔗 How to engage in Health Profession events & connect with Health Profession Student Organizations
💉 How to gain shadowing, volunteering, and clinical experiences
🗓️ Plan for application deadlines



NOTE: ⏰Please arrive on time. Latecomers will be encouraged to attend future Health Profession Labs. See Handshake Events for future lab dates.  This lab will not cover in-depth specific pathways or specific classes that you will need to take. The resources provided in this lab will help you navigate necessary information then empower you to direct your questions to the appropriate departments.
